Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the State, considering the material on record, particularly the affidavit dated 17.10.2023 filed on behalf of the petitioner through his son, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner subject to such stringent terms and conditions that would be imposed as would be deemed fit and property by the learned court in seisin of the matter including the pre-condition as stated in the affidavit at paragraph-3 that before the learned court in seisin of the matter, the petitioner without prejudice to his rights and contentions shall deposit an amount of Rs.3,00,000/-(Rupees Three Lakhs) only along with property security to the tune of Rs.12,00,000/- (Rupees Twelve Lakhs).
The learned court shall have the liberty to deposit the amount in a fixed deposit in any nationalized bank with auto renewal clause.
